prompt: In a grand, crowded ballroom, a male dancer in a black tailcoat is dipping a female dancer in a flowing red dress. A massive crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, directly above the dancing couple. To their left, a small orchestra is on a raised stage. The orchestra has four violinists, and the number of cellists is half the number of violinists. The conductor is standing in front of the orchestra, pointing a baton at the violin section. Along the ballroom walls stand several stone statues; their number is one more than the number of cellists. The light from the chandelier is brighter than any other light source in the room. The female dancer's dress is touching the polished wooden floor. The male dancer is looking at the female dancer, who is looking up at him. The male dancer is slightly taller than the female dancer. A single white glove, dropped by the female dancer, is lying on the floor between the dancing couple and the stage. The male dancer's shoe is lightly touching the hem of the female dancer's dress. The female dancer is holding a closed fan in her hand. The chandelier is suspended higher than the top of the statues. The orchestra is playing instruments.
